title: Codex Sidecar
description: Watch Codex work, live, in a pane beside Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot or another coding agent, and step in while it works. Windows; macOS and Linux experimental.

title: Pixel Pal
description: エクスプローラーに好きなドット絵ペットを表示する拡張機能。素材フォルダを差し替えて自作キャラクターにでき、AIでペットを作るスキルも同梱。

title: Flutter DB Inspector
description: Inspect, query and edit your running Flutter app's local databases — SQLite, Drift, Isar, Hive, SharedPreferences and more — without copying database files.

title: HariTrail
description: Watch Claude Code work through your codebase live: every file it reads, edits and creates, every command and test, and every loop back after a failure. See it as a journey, a map of your project or lanes over time, and replay it step by step.

title: Estuary
description: The Estuary theme of @iscor/design, in light and dark: off-white, ink and one lime accent.

title: VS Code 工具箱
description: 在底部工具箱管理工作区文件、VS Code 命令和 Copilot 消息。
